body: 小野藥品 ONO-2808（S1P5 促效劑）樞紐性 Ph3 試驗（NCT07825402）於 2026/09/17 登錄 CT.gov，尚未開始收案：隨機雙盲安慰劑對照、口服、限 MSA-P 亞型、療程 48 週，估計 2027/01 開始收案、2029/10 主要完成。承接 2026/05 WPC 發表之 Ph2 核心數據（MSA-P 次族群 mUMSARS 變化：安慰劑 3.90 vs 高劑量 1.16）。
note: → 登錄未載入組人數與收案地點，屬 Ph2→Ph3 銜接的正式里程碑，非新療效數據。

en.body: Ono's ONO-2808 (S1P5 agonist) pivotal Ph3 trial (NCT07825402) was registered on CT.gov on 2026/09/17 and is not yet recruiting: randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled, oral, restricted to the MSA-P subtype, 48-week treatment; estimated start 2027/01 and primary completion 2029/10. It follows the Ph2 core data presented at WPC in 2026/05 (MSA-P subgroup mUMSARS change: 3.90 placebo vs 1.16 high dose).
en.note: → The registration does not yet give enrollment size or sites; this is a formal Ph2-to-Ph3 milestone, not new efficacy data.

body: Alterity ATH434 取得美國專利商標局新核准的物質組成專利：保護範圍為 ATH434甲磺酸鹽的特定結晶型，並涵蓋以該結晶型治療神經疾病的方法。公司表示此專利將保護期延長至至少 2045 年（自核准日起逾 18 年），且此結晶型即為 Ph2 MSA 試驗所用、亦將用於規劃中的 Ph3。
note: → 這是專利事項、非臨床或法規進展，本身不構成療效或安全性訊息。與 2026/07 的 FDA End-of-Phase-2 註冊路徑一併看，反映該案正在為公司稱 2026 年底啟動的 Ph3 作業鋪路。公司另稱此專利有利於未來拓展至帕金森病等涉及鐵代謝失衡與蛋白聚集的疾病。新聞稿未載專利號。

en.body: Alterity's ATH434 has been granted a new US composition-of-matter patent by the USPTO, covering a specific crystalline form of the mesylate salt of ATH434 together with methods of treating neurological conditions using it. The company states the patent extends protection to at least 2045 — more than 18 years from the grant date — and that this is the form used in the Ph2 MSA trials and intended for the planned Ph3.
en.note: → This is an intellectual-property matter rather than clinical or regulatory progress, and carries no information about efficacy or safety in itself. Read alongside the FDA End-of-Phase-2 registrational pathway of July 2026, it reflects groundwork for the Ph3 activities the company says will begin by the end of 2026. The company also states the patent supports future development in Parkinson's disease and other conditions involving disturbed iron handling and protein aggregation. The release does not give a patent number.

body: SCA-IQ（姊妹站）新增「合作機會」頁：涵蓋 12 個市場、三層對象（競品／治療型／製造生態系）共 68 家的合作角度分析與市場覆蓋地圖。MSA 領域的細胞治療與 CDMO 生態系與 SCA 高度重疊，相關對象一併收錄於該頁並標記「亦與 MSA 相關」。
note: → 細胞治療的製造與供應鏈是跨疾病共用的，兩站不重複維護同一份合作分析。

en.body: SCA-IQ has added a Partnering tab: a partnering assessment and market coverage map spanning 68 companies across 12 markets and three layers (rivals, therapeutic developers, and the manufacturing ecosystem). Cell therapy and CDMO ecosystems overlap heavily between MSA and SCA, so the relevant counterparties are covered there and flagged as also relevant to MSA.
en.note: Manufacturing and supply chains in cell therapy are shared across diseases, so the same partnering analysis is not maintained twice.

body: 掃描盤點目前已登錄的 α-synuclein PET 造影示蹤劑臨床研究，MSA 均列為目標族群：MODAG GmbH 的 [¹⁸F]MODAG-009（NCT07640555，Early Ph1，n=13，收案中，美國 Institute for Neurodegenerative Disorders／XingImaging，主要指標 SUVR，主要完成估 2027/05）與 [¹¹C]MODAG-005 再測信度先導研究（NCT07640542，Early Ph1，2026/07/29 已啟動收案，n=9、德國圖賓根大學醫院核醫科單中心，主要指標為注射後 4 日內之安全性與耐受性，主要完成估 2027/07）；另有 Synusight Biotech（上海）的 SST001（NCT07604116，Ph1、n=30，2026/06/15 起於上海華山醫院與江南大學附屬醫院收案，評估安全性、生物分佈、輻射劑量與藥動，主要完成估 2026/12）。
note: → 這些是造影示蹤劑而非治療藥物，故未列入試驗雷達。MSA 目前缺乏可在活體量化 α-synuclein 病理負荷的工具，臨床試驗多依賴 UMSARS 與腦部體積等間接指標；若示蹤劑取得驗證，將影響未來試驗的受試者分層與藥效藥理終點設計。

en.body: The sweep took stock of the α-synuclein PET tracer studies currently registered, all of which include MSA as a target population: MODAG GmbH's [¹⁸F]MODAG-009 (NCT07640555, Early Ph1, n=13, recruiting at the Institute for Neurodegenerative Disorders / XingImaging in the US, SUVR as the primary measure, primary completion estimated 2027/05) and its [¹¹C]MODAG-005 test-retest pilot (NCT07640542, Early Ph1, which opened to recruitment on 29 July 2026 with n=9 at a single site, the nuclear medicine department of Tübingen University Hospital in Germany, safety and tolerability through four days post-injection as the primary measure and primary completion estimated 2027/07); plus Synusight Biotech (Shanghai)'s SST001 (NCT07604116, Ph1, n=30, recruiting since 15 June 2026 at Huashan Hospital in Shanghai and the Affiliated Hospital of Jiangnan University, assessing safety, biodistribution, radiation dosimetry and pharmacokinetics, primary completion estimated 2026/12).
en.note: → These are imaging tracers rather than treatments, so they are not listed on the trial radar. MSA currently lacks a tool for quantifying α-synuclein pathology in living patients, and trials rely on indirect measures such as UMSARS and brain volume; a validated tracer would change how future trials stratify participants and design pharmacodynamic endpoints.

body: Alterity ATH434 公布 FDA End-of-Phase-2 會議紀錄，確認 MSA 註冊路徑：Ph3 約 200 人、1:1 隨機 50mg 或安慰劑、每日兩次共 12 個月，主要終點 11 項 UMSARS Part I，次要終點含吞嚥障礙問卷、姿勢性低血壓症狀評估與 CGI-S；FDA 同意單一樞紐試驗加確認性證據即可支持核准。
note: → 公司稱 2026 年底前啟動 Ph3 作業。這是 MSA 領域少見已與 FDA 就樞紐設計取得一致的案例。

en.body: Alterity's ATH434 released FDA End-of-Phase-2 meeting minutes confirming its registrational pathway in MSA: a Ph3 of roughly 200 patients randomised 1:1 to 50mg or placebo twice daily for 12 months, with the 11-item UMSARS Part I as the primary endpoint and secondary endpoints including the Swallowing Disturbance Questionnaire, the Orthostatic Hypotension Symptom Assessment and CGI-S. The FDA agreed that a single pivotal trial plus confirmatory evidence could support approval.
en.note: → The company says Ph3 activities will begin by the end of 2026. Few MSA programmes have reached explicit FDA alignment on a pivotal design.

body: 小野藥品 ONO-2808（S1P5 促效劑）於世界帕金森大會發表 Ph2 24 週核心數據：MSA-P 次族群 mUMSARS 變化 安慰劑 3.90 vs 高劑量 1.16；規劃樞紐 Ph3。
note: → 非 α-synuclein 標的的第二個正面訊號；屬次族群分析。

en.body: Ono's ONO-2808 (S1P5 agonist) presented 24-week Ph2 core data at the World Parkinson Congress: in the MSA-P subgroup, mUMSARS change was 3.90 on placebo vs 1.16 on the high dose; a pivotal Ph3 is planned.
en.note: → A second positive signal from a non-alpha-synuclein target; based on a subgroup analysis.

body: Lundbeck amlenetug 的 Ph3 MASCOT（NCT06706622）已停止收案、試驗進行中，主要完成預估 2028/02——目前 MSA 唯一在跑的 Ph3 疾病修飾試驗。
note: → Ph2 AMULET 主要終點未達（減緩 19%、未達顯著）仍進 Ph3。

en.body: Lundbeck's amlenetug Ph3 MASCOT (NCT06706622) has closed enrolment and is ongoing, with primary completion estimated 2028/02 — currently the only Ph3 disease-modifying trial running in MSA.
en.note: → It advanced despite the Ph2 AMULET missing its primary endpoint (19% slowing, not significant).
